{{Quote|Subject has detailed knowledge of Trade Federation encryption codes and is an expert at forged identities|Onicrop K'Cin's bounty brief|<ref name="Prima" />}}
'''Onicrop K'Cin''' was an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and light skin [[Homeworld/Legends|from]]<ref name="Prima" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]]. He was affiliated with code breakers and the [[Galactic Podracing Mechanics' Union]]. The Ugnaught wore a dark gray [[Clothing/Legends|apron]] over lighter gray clothing.<ref name="Prima" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> he obtained detailed knowledge of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] encryption codes and became an expert at [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forging]] identities. For his knowledge, the [[Trade Federation Recruitment Center]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on K'Cin's head, offering 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for his capture or 750 upon [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Prima" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> K'Cin was present in [[Merchant Row (Outland Station)|Merchant Row]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Outland Transit Station|Outland Station]]. While the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was in pursuit of the criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]] on the station, the hunter captured the Ugnaught alive for the full sum of credits.<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Onicrop K'Cin first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', developed by [[LucasArts]]. Onicrop K'Cin is an ananym of [[Nick Porcino]], a programmer for ''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter''. In the game, the Ugnaught is the second optional secondary bounty that the player can capture in the mission "Merchant Row" and is the sixth overall. K'Cin is able to be captured by the player for a higher sum of credits or killed for a lower amount.<ref name="BH" /> This article assumes that K'Cin was captured alive for the full sum of credits.
